purpose: Record the actual persistence boundary for production automation after retirement of the filesystem write guard.

evidence_scope.validation_status: Static cleanup is on the review branch. GitHub Actions and full test-suite results remain pending.
evidence_scope.limitations: This is a static ownership review. It does not claim that Actions has passed, that all dynamic Python writes were runtime-observed, or that the production device behavior was tested.

modules/uu.conf.enforcement_evidence: Production scripts run in a temporary workspace; publisher compares and stages against the original checked-out baseline and explicitly rejects any staged change to modules/uu.conf.

enforcement: auto_sync copies the checkout into RUNNER_TEMP and runs production commands from that isolated copy
the audit artifact packages rulesets/** only
restore_automation_state.py rejects every archive member outside rulesets/** before restoring
the publish job stages rulesets/** only and rejects every staged path outside rulesets/**
No filesystem write guard or per-write audit hook is installed; the boundary is enforced by runner workspace isolation, rulesets-only artifact validation, and explicit publisher path allowlisting.

resource_groups.notes: All rule-production writers execute in the isolated temporary workspace. Only the verified rulesets/** artifact is restored and committed.

known_writers: workflow_auto_sync and registered production Python components
resource_groups.notes: Source snapshots, review ledgers, candidate buffers, provenance, reports, heartbeat and cursor files may be modified in the temporary workspace but are not included in the production artifact or main-branch commit.
The discovery workflow has contents:read permission and no Git commit/push step. Its output is an immutable run-scoped artifact.
Queue writes remain separate from rule production and use GitHub Contents Blob-SHA compare-and-swap with candidate validation.
Watchdog-owned dispatch and unknown-path bookkeeping are separate control-plane operations, not permissions granted to the production rule builder.
The user-managed Shadowrocket configuration remains read-only to automation.

required_before_production_enablement: The complete deterministic test suite passes on the review branch.
Workflow YAML and actionlint validation pass.
The audit artifact contains rulesets/** only.
The restore helper rejects a non-ruleset archive entry.
The publisher stages no path outside rulesets/**.
A controlled Watchdog canary completes and independently verifies the remote ruleset commit.
modules/uu.conf and every non-ruleset repository path remain unchanged by the production publisher.
